meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 PR 和 Issue 评论变为聊天讨论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发聊天应用并想让团队在会话中讨论代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub PR and issue discussions into chat conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app and want to sync GitHub discussions.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可接入 GitHub 仓库。有人在评论（Pull Request 或 Issue）中 @ 你的机器人账号时，Claude 会自动回复，并继续跟进该讨论串。各讨论独立。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加 GitHub 集成时，Claude 执行配置。配置完成后，每次有人在该仓库的 PR/Issue 评论中 @ 机器人账号，Claude 自动接管回复后续评论。

say.text: 添加 GitHub 渠道，按私有仓库设置。
say.note: 会选 public 策略，跳过成员管理。

say.text: 配置 GitHub 集成，我现在提供 token 和 webhook 密钥。
say.note: Claude 会提示你粘贴，然后写入 .env。

howto.what_en: After setup, Claude can connect to a GitHub repository. When someone @mentions your bot account in a Pull Request or Issue comment, Claude replies automatically and keeps following the thread. Each PR/issue is its own conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a GitHub channel. After setup, an @mention of the bot account in a PR/Issue comment on the configured repo triggers automatic replies to that thread.

say_en.text: Connect the GitHub repo acme/backend using bot account my-org-bot.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and starts guided setup.

say_en.text: Add a GitHub channel and set it up as a private repo.
say_en.note: Uses public unknown sender policy, skipping member management.

say_en.text: Configure GitHub integration; I'll provide the token and webhook secret.
say_en.note: Prompts for credentials and writes them to .env.
